scope: Algebraic analysis of existing corrected scores/outcomes and existing final rows only. No new model, environment, DTW, teacher label, GT, or checkpoint-weight evaluation.

formula.reward: R = 2*success + S_V; split stored branch and stored parent scores into these two summands.
formula.reported_norm: Concatenate four per-parent raw-action credit arrays after multiplying each by T_e/4; take Euclidean norm. This is before the native policy Jacobian, global gradient clipping, Adam, and trust scaling.

caveats: The two videos share each task/initial-state MT and no-video controls; pooled 256 rows are descriptive, not independent new control observations.
Practice baseline 34/64 counts the 32 unique shared bootstrap episodes twice, once per video condition.
Five video conditions retain MT300; their final differences cannot be attributed to parameter learning. no_video also retains MT300 for all eight tasks.
Task32/video1 has three video-only accepted updates followed by one mixed accepted update; final gain cannot be assigned solely to video-only updates or to an individual intermediate checkpoint.
No final outcomes enter optimization or acceptance. These eight tasks are internal non-held probes, not the formal held paired400 benchmark.
Raw-action credit dominance and cosine do not identify dominance after the native Jacobian, Adam, or accumulated path-dependent updates.
